x-e-e4-01.title: Mama note and Jisu playtime
x-e-e4-01.goal: Compare di different plans for Mama note with di time wey friend suggest, find where dem no fit together, then say no for English and suggest another time.

Note wey Mama leave for table (na text only, no picture):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Throw away di trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mama and Papa.

Then her friend Jisu send message. "Make we play for park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"

x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Judge whether one time 'range' and one time overlap
x-e-e4-01.thinking.2: Explain am for English with evidence

x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Easy words like piano class and trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Choose all di lines for di note wey overlap in time with Jisu suggestion (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Put each line beside di park time '4:15-5:15' one by one, and check whether e finish before or start after.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: For things wey take time, like class, work out wetin time dem go finish.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Compare whether di time you reach house na before or after 4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Work out di time wey class start and di time e finish, then put am beside di park time.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: I treat am as checking whether one time fall inside di park time range.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Compare whether dinner time come after di park time finish.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Piano class na 4:00-4:30, so 4:15-4:30 overlap, and throwing away trash for 5:00 fall inside 4:15-5:15. Coming home for 3:30 and dinner for 6:30 dey outside di park time.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Reply Jisu with two or three English sentences. Find di reasons for di note why you no fit go, write dem, then suggest another time wey go work.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: First, say no for one sentence with 'Sorry, I can't ...'.

x-e-e4-02.title: Decide dog-walking and homework times
x-e-e4-02.goal: Make some different combinations of dog-walking time and homework time wey meet all di conditions for Dad note.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Note wey Dad leave (na text only, no picture):

Mina,
You dey come home for 4:00 p.m. I dey come home for 6:30 p.m.
- Walk di dog for 30 minutes. No do am before 5:00 p.m. E too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.

- Finish both before I come home.
- No do both at di same time.
For down, write each time as 'how many minutes after 4:00 p.m.'. For example, if you start for 4:30, write 30, and if you start for 5:15, write 75.

x-e-e4-02.thinking.2: Check whether dem overlap each other
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Easy words like walk di dog and homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: If Mina start homework for 5:00 and walk for 5:30, which condition for di note she break?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Add di time wey each task take (in minutes) to di task start time to find di finish time.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Draw di time ranges for both tasks side by side for one line.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Compare whether di walk start time 5:30 come before or after 5:00.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Put homework 5:00-6:00 and di walk 5:30-6:00 side by side for timeline.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Find di finish time for both tasks by adding di time each one take to its start time.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: This condition na about how long di task take, no be about di start time.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Homework na 5:00-6:00 and di walk na 5:30-6:00, so both tasks overlap from 5:30 to 6:00. Di walk start after 5:00 and both finish before 6:30, so dem keep di other conditions.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Make 3 different plans wey keep all di conditions for di note. w na di walk start and k na di homework start (how many minutes after 4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: First decide di range wey w fit be for di walk start, then choose homework start k wey no overlap with di walk time.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Find di finish time by adding how long each task take to its start time, then check whether both tasks overlap.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Di time dey di correct format.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Write w and k as whole numbers (minutes) wey be 0 or more.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Di walk or homework finish after 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Di walk and homework times overlap.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Di walk must start between 60 and 120 minutes (5:00-6:00), and homework must start within 90 minutes (by 5:30). From those, answers na combinations wey no overlap. Examples: (walk 60, homework 0), (walk 90, homework 0), (walk 60, homework 90).
